scale.4: Professionally useful draft with explicit manageable gaps
scale.5: Clear, proportionate and well-grounded for the stated early-planning purpose

criteria.need_reasoning: Development need and reasoning grounded in the original fictional source
criteria.objective_activity_alignment: Clear intended change and credible objective/activity/work-package pathway
criteria.results_indicator_realism: Outputs separated from results/impact; meaningful measurement rather than attendance alone
criteria.scope_implementation: Duration, reach, capacity, risks and follow-up proportionate to claimed impact
criteria.critical_review: Review identifies consequential scope/implementation/claim gaps using correct source evidence
criteria.unsupported_facts_language: No invented facts, eligibility, partners, budgets or commitments; professional requested language

rules: Structural/schema completeness and reference checks are automated facts, not these subjective scores.
Human scores remain null until supplied by a person, with field/ID evidence.
AI-assisted judgments are recorded separately and never labelled independent human assessment.
Critical review applies to review outputs; leave other non-applicable criteria null and explain in notes.
One work package is not inherently inadequate; compare actual intervention and claims.
Latency, tokens and cost are measured/recorded separately, never inferred from prose.
